# Tabs

Container for a set of tabs, built on react-aria-components `Tabs`. Compose `TabList` (holding `Tab` triggers) with one `TabPanel` per tab; matching `id`s wire each trigger to its panel. Selection state, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End), and ARIA `tablist`/`tab`/`tabpanel` wiring all come from React Aria; visual states are driven purely by RAC data attributes (`data-selected`, `data-hovered`, `data-focus-visible`, `data-disabled`) and `--ds-*` tokens. Horizontal only in v1.

Import: `import { Tabs } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Built on react-aria-components `Tabs`; keyboard behavior, ARIA, and focus management ship inside. All `Tabs` base props (e.g. event handlers, `isDisabled`, `autoFocus`) are also legal here, with the props listed below overriding or narrowing them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Narrowed from the react-aria-components render-prop form to a plain string; inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |

## Accessibility

- Keyboard behavior, ARIA semantics, and focus management come from react-aria-components `Tabs` — never re-implement or bypass them.
- Interaction states are exposed as data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`, …); the focus-visible ring uses `var(--ds-color-border-focus)` and `var(--ds-shadow-focus-ring)`.
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Tabs defaultSelectedKey="overview">
  <TabList aria-label="Project sections">
    <Tab id="overview">Overview</Tab>
    <Tab id="settings">Settings</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel id="overview">Overview content</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel id="settings">Settings content</TabPanel>
</Tabs>
```
